goal: Verify fault injection: idempotent delivery, latch behavior, intent refusal, consent gating.

tasks.goal: Submit the same operation with the same idempotency key twice; verify no duplication.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains executed: true and duplicate_count is 0

tasks.goal: Start a long-running operation and cancel it; verify the latch prevents post-cancel mutations.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains cancelled: true and no mutations after cancel

tasks.goal: Submit an unknown intent and verify it is refused with an error code.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains error code indicating unknown_intent

tasks.goal: Submit a request matching multiple providers and verify ambiguity refusal.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains error code indicating ambiguity

tasks.goal: Submit a high-risk operation without consent and verify it is blocked.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains error code indicating consent_required

tasks.goal: Attempt mTLS request with an unpaired identity and verify refusal.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains error code indicating identity_not_paired

tasks.goal: Replay a previously accepted nonce and verify it is refused.
tasks.final_verifier: second attempt contains error code indicating nonce_replay
